recipes.name: Classic Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: In a small bowl, combine flour, baking soda, and salt.
In a large bowl, beat butter, granulated sugar, brown sugar, and vanilla until creamy.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto ungreased baking sheets.
Bake for 9 to 11 minutes or until golden brown.
Cool on baking sheets for 2 minutes; remove to wire racks to cool completely.
notes: For chewier cookies, chill dough for 30 minutes before baking.
Store in an airtight container for up to 5 days.

recipes.name: Avocado Toast with Poached Eggs
ingredients: Fresh cilantro or parsley for garnish
instructions: Fill a large saucepan with water, add vinegar, and bring to a simmer.
Crack eggs into separate small cups.
Create a whirlpool in the simmering water and gently slide eggs in.
Poach for 3-4 minutes until whites are set but yolks are still runny.
Remove eggs with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Toast bread until golden and crisp.
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Top with poached eggs, red pepper flakes, and fresh herbs.
Season with additional salt and pepper if needed.
notes: Use the freshest eggs possible for best poaching results.
Add sliced radishes or microgreens for extra crunch and flavor.
